Trader walked me through how he trades gold. XAUUSD, London session.

He runs two charts. The 4H is the one that tells him which way he is allowed
to trade, and the 5m is where he actually gets in.

On the 4H he waits for a strong trend before he will look at anything at
all. If it is not there he does not trade.

Once he has that, he drops to the 5m and takes a clean breakout in the same
direction as the 4H.

One entry per setup. He does not add.
